Flexible Epidemic Modeling with epidemia

Source: R/epidemia-package.R
epidemia-package.Rd

The epidemia package allows researchers to flexibly specify and fit Bayesian epidemiological models in the style of Flaxman et al. (2020) . The package leverages R's formula interface to parameterize the reproduction rate in terms of covariates, and allows pooling of parameters. The design of the package has been inspired by, and borrowed from, the rstanarm package (Goodrich et al. 2020) . epidemia uses cmdstanr as the backend for fitting the models, and the posterior package to represent posterior draws. The primary model fitting function in epidemia is epim.
